messages:
maya: Kicking off SJC4 GPU cluster bring-up — posting a concise capacity & safety gate checklist. Please :thumbsup: and add missing checks.

ops-bot: preflight scan complete. Inventory upload OK. Missing quotas flagged (region metadata).

eli: FYI provider quota shows 45/48 A100 available right now. I've opened a reservation request.

devops-jen: Created ticket INFR-2134 to request remaining 3 GPUs, pinged account team. ETA ~2h.

sam: NVLink health probe: passed on 8 nodes, 4 nodes show intermittent NVLink flaps, filing HW ticket.

lena: Network quick check: BGP sessions 10/10, but edge-router-3 not announcing the /22 to peer-A. Reconfiguring now.

maya: Can someone run these smoke commands and paste outputs?
```
# quick node + daemon status
kubectl get nodes -o wide
NAME	STATUS	ROLES	AGE	VERSION
...
```

eli: Paste from cluster: `k get nodes` -> 24 nodes total, 23 Ready, 1 NotReady (k8s-sjc4-gpu-17). NVIDIA driver crashed on that node.

devops-jen: Restarting kubelet + driver on k8s-sjc4-gpu-17 now: `ssh ops@k8s-sjc4-gpu-17 'sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced && sudo systemctl restart kubelet'`.

ops-bot: hardware ticket #HW-449 created for PCIe lane instability on 4 hosts.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: service=llm-inference, initial 10% traffic, health probe=HTTP 200, latency SLO p95 <250ms.

sam: Canary metrics at 15m: p50=60ms, p95=220ms. Slight spike observed at minute 7 coinciding with batch job. Investigating batching config.

lena: Cost gate check: first-month estimate (soft launch) =~ $82,000. Budget target was $75,000. Recommendation: enable conservative autoscaling policy and apply quantization profile q8_nonprod for dev/canary.

maya: Decision call: proceed with soft launch but cap burst to 60% of reserved pool, enable q8_nonprod for non-prod routes, and re-evaluate after 6h. On-call: @eli for next 4h, final handoff to platform at 21:00 PDT. :thumbsup:

eli: Ack. Monitoring alerts set.

devops-jen: Documented steps + rollback are in the runbook: http://go/runbooks/sjc4-gpu-boot (runbook index, safe rollback is draining canary nodes and routing to fallback model).

deploy-bot: Canary -> 30% traffic. No failed healthchecks reported.

maya: Checklist update: bootstrap ✅, images ✅, NVLink partial (8/12 ✅, HW ticket for 4 hosts), BGP ✅, monitoring ✅, cost gate (soft) ✅, canary ✅. Open items: HW-449, quota fulfillment INFR-2134.

sam: I'll follow HW-449 and post updates.

lena: Transferring to eng-oncall channel for final signoff, leaving this thread as the single source of truth for the bootstrap.

ops-bot: Auto-reminder set: if p95 >250ms for 15m, trigger incident.

maya: Thanks team — handoff complete, will reconvene after 6h to reassess capacity and costs.
